svg.title: Our character-level Transformer
svg.desc: Architecture of the implemented one-block decoder-only Transformer. The input F i r s is converted to character and position embeddings. Inside one causal block, layer normalisation precedes single-head causal self-attention, whose output is added to the embeddings through a residual connection. Another layer normalisation and feed-forward network are followed by a second residual addition. Final layer normalisation and an output projection give 65 vocabulary scores at each position. For generation, the final position is converted to a next-character probability distribution, one character is sampled and appended to the context, and the process repeats. The small four-by-four mask is schematic and not learned attention weights.
